title: Turquoise Trail Campground

services.name: Camp Sites
services.desc: Our pull-thru and back-in RV sites fit teardrop campers to large class A motor homes and have 20-amp, 30-amp and 50-amp outputs. Enjoy our full hook-up sites after a day of traveling or exploring the Turquoise Trail National Scenic Byway, Sandia Mountains, artist communities and historical sites. Our 30 primitive campsites are situated away from our RV sites on two private loops and provide peace and quiet in a wooded environment. Access to a dedicated tent pad, picnic table, bathroom and shower facility and National Forest trails included. Propane fire pit and grill available at the Front Desk. blurb: Located in central New Mexico’s enchanting Sandia Mountains along the Turquoise Trail National Scenic Byway, we are your adventure outpost. Our quiet, cool, starry nights offer the perfect recharge from days of exploring world class hiking and riding trails, skiing, restaurants, museums, historic mining towns, cultural sites and so much more.
